title: Factorizable Lie conformal bialgebras, quadratic Rota-Baxter Lie conformal algebras and some induced structures
summary: We introduce the notion of factorizable Lie conformal bialgebras and establish their correspondence with quadratic Rota-Baxter Lie conformal algebras of nonzero weight. Consequently, on the one hand, a Lie conformal bialgebra with a Rota-Baxter operator of nonzero weight gives a factorizable Lie conformal bialgebra.
